scope: OS-independent user-owned synthetic journal contract; no root/UAC native broker and no trusted OS-held ledger
reason: Prevent accidentally restarting a policy/request id from scratch after a durable reserve or process crash; enable only explicit exact-identity recovery rather than treating a prior request id as new

implementation.mode: file-only synthetic replay control, NO elevated native actions
implementation.storage: one bounded `broker-replay.json` within the existing Engine state lock root; `Engine.locked()` (Windows byte lock, Linux flock) and existing atomic_json/fsync, no new OS permissions
implementation.requests: reuses R899 compare_pinned_policy_intent() with caller-provided, not authentically publisher-protected policy pin; exact request ID 128-bit lowercase hex + SHA256 of request bytes + policy SHA256 bound to active record
implementation.state_machine: absent -> reserved -> applying -> tombstoned (synthetic completed or aborted); no native service can be accepted by this API
implementation.recovery: fault after durable reserve or applying -> reopen state, require exact id+request and policy SHA, return RECOVERY_REQUIRED_NOT_NEW_PRIVILEGED_WORK; no duplicate reserve; no callback-executed native work
implementation.uniqueness: used request IDs retained in same file, no eviction; capacity 256 => fail-closed and require independently authorized policy epoch rotation outside fixture
implementation.foreign_tamper_refusal: duplicate JSON keys, duplicate reserved ID, missing active ID in history, unsupported platform/state/role/outcome, stale *.writing and symlink journal rejected

windows.reason_for_skip: Windows unprivileged symlink creation unavailable; POSIX real symlink test PASS

linux.unprivileged_temporary_source_copy: SHA-pinned exact to Windows source and removed

crossprocess.simultaneous_independent_workers_for_sam: one success, one fail closed on both Windows and Linux

limitation: This is NOT a trusted OS-privileged replay ledger: directory is user-owned in tests, caller-supplied policy hash not publisher auth; Windows power cut durability and Linux root-owned handle-bound protected writes unproven. Never authorize root/SCM actions solely from this fixture.
